meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 원가의 출발점을 설비 하나로 세운다 — 석탄 화력 냉각탑과 폴리실리콘 반응로 앞에서 오성홍기 구체가 전기 계량기 다이얼 '41'을 손가락으로 짚으며 능청스럽게 웃는다. 「신장 전기 kWh당 0.03달러(약 41원), 폴리실리콘 원가의 40%가 전기값」(verified-data §4)이 근거이며, 표정 온도는 상대=여유·계산으로 잡았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth plain concrete factory floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a colossal coal-fired power-station cooling tower and a bank of tall polysilicon reactor vessels dominate the upper five-eighths in crisp mechanical detail, steam and coal smoke pouring off them, high-voltage pylons receding into a blurred industrial skyline. Bolted to the nearest reactor at mid height is a huge analogue electricity meter whose dial reads the numerals '41' beside a glowing red indicator lamp. In front of it, framed chest-up, a countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — dressed in a grey work uniform with small black gloved hands, one gloved finger tapping the meter dial; its eyes are narrowed to smug slits and one corner of its mouth curls up in a sly grin. Three dull blue-grey polysilicon wafer shards float on spark trails at mid height beside it.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 값이 멈춘 지점을 접촉으로 만든다 — 성조기 구체의 손이 컨테이너 문에 붉은 억류 태그를 직접 눌러 붙이고, 오성홍기 구체는 문을 붙잡고 경악한다. 「2026년 2월 기준 누계 억류 39억 4천만 달러(약 5조 4천억 원), 반입 거부 37%」(verified-data §2)가 근거다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth plain asphalt dock apron — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Scene: a US customs port gate. At the centre of the upper five-eighths, huge and crisply detailed, a steel shipping container stands with its doors bolted shut. On the right a countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the US flag — red and white stripes with a blue canton of white stars — in a dark navy customs uniform and peaked cap, its small black gloved hand pressing a bright red hold tag flat onto the container door, face utterly deadpan with flat half-closed eyes and a straight line for a mouth. On the left a countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — in a business suit, both gloved hands clamped on the container's edge, eyes bulging white with pupils shrunk to pinpricks, mouth wide open in a shout, sweat droplets flying off its surface and shock lines radiating behind it. A blurred wall of stacked red-tagged containers and harbour cranes fills the background.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 「187곳을 잘라냈다」를 크레인이 화물 블록을 통째로 격리 구역으로 옮기는 동작으로 이행한다 — 격리 펜스의 '187'은 2026년 7월 31일 43곳 추가로 명단이 총 187곳이 된 사실(verified-data §1)이다. 성조기 구체는 조종석에서 확신, 오성홍기 구체는 아래에서 작게 두 손을 든다.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 앵커 001은 「가장 촘촘한 감시망을 세운 자가 자기가 만든 그 스캔 광선 아래에서 굳어 있다」였다 — 우리 편은 「사람을 묶어 만든 그 값이 지금 그 물건을 항구에 묶어 놓았다」로 옮긴다. / [남김] ①우측 얼굴이 화면 오른쪽 3분의 1을 채우는 배치 ②좌측 붉은 원 강조 ③상단을 가로지르는 붉은 스캔 광선 + 사각 인식 프레임 ④화염과 검은 연기가 오성홍기를 덮은 배경 ⑤눈높이 정면 와이드앵글 / [바꿈] ⓐ원 안의 대상: 위구르 노인 → 반으로 잘린 임금 봉투 ⓑ상단 장치: 중국 감시 드론 편대 → 미 세관 X선 검사 갠트리 ⓒ표정: 경악한 눈 → 내리깐 눈과 굳게 다문 입 + 땀 한 방울. 앵커의 붉은 원은 하단에 있었으나 이 계열 세이프존 규칙에 맞춰 좌측 중단으로 올렸다.
